summary: Tested new FAB toggle with Park/Retrieve options and vehicle lookup/retrieve flow. All 11 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI tests verified FAB toggle, Park/Retrieve buttons, retrieve modal, and stat cards for both valet and admin roles.

Backend: GET /api/vehicles/lookup returns vehicle info with has_active_ticket flag
Backend: GET /api/vehicles/lookup returns 404 for unknown phone
Backend: GET /api/vehicles/lookup normalizes phone number (adds + if missing)
Backend: POST /api/tickets/retrieve requires authentication
Backend: POST /api/tickets/retrieve returns 400 if ticket already exists
Backend: POST /api/tickets/retrieve returns 404 for unknown phone
Backend: POST /api/tickets/retrieve creates ticket with status=claimed and claimed_by=valet_id
Backend: POST /api/tickets/retrieve second attempt fails with 400
Backend: Lookup shows has_active_ticket=false for newly parked vehicle
Backend: Lookup shows has_active_ticket=true after retrieve initiated
Frontend: fab-toggle-button found and clickable
Frontend: fab-park-button appears when FAB is open
Frontend: fab-retrieve-button appears when FAB is open
Frontend: Park button navigates to /intake page
Frontend: Retrieve button opens retrieve-modal
Frontend: retrieve-phone-input found in modal
Frontend: retrieve-lookup-button found in modal
Frontend: Valet stat cards (valet-card-parked, valet-card-retrieved, valet-card-tips) shown for valet role
Frontend: Admin stat cards (card-active-valets, card-vehicles, card-tips) shown for admin role

context_for_next_testing_agent: FAB toggle feature is fully working.
